title: GitSinkConfig
description: Configuration for Git-based sinks using REST/GraphQL APIs. Supports GitHub (GraphQL), GitLab (REST), and Bitbucket (REST).

gitCredentialsType.title: Credentials Type
gitCredentialsType.description: Type of authentication for Git API operations.

conflictResolution.title: Conflict Resolution
conflictResolution.description: How to handle files that were modified directly in git.

repositoryUrl.title: Repository URL
repositoryUrl.description: Git repository URL (HTTPS format). Example: https://github.com/org/repo.git

basePath.title: Base Path
basePath.description: Base directory path in the repository for metadata files.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Custom API base URL for GitHub Enterprise. Leave empty for github.com. Example: https://github.mycompany.com/api

credentials.title: Git Credentials
credentials.description: Authentication credentials for Git API operations.

token.title: Access Token
token.description: Personal access token or GitHub App token for authentication. Supports secret references (e.g., secret:/path/to/token).

signingKey.title: Commit Signing Key
signingKey.description: OpenPGP key the sink signs its pushed commits with. GitHub shows them as Verified when the key's public half is on the GitHub account of the key's email. Without it, commits go through the GitHub API, unless unsigned fast pushes are allowed.

privateKey.title: Private Key
privateKey.description: ASCII-armored OpenPGP private key (-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----). Commits are authored as the key's first user ID with an email. Supports secret references (e.g., secret:/path/to/key).

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key, if it has one. Supports secret references.

allowUnsignedFastPush.title: Allow Unsigned Fast Push
allowUnsignedFastPush.description: Without a signing key, push unsigned commits with git instead of committing through the GitHub API. Faster, but GitHub shows the commits as unverified, and branches that require signed commits reject them.

syncMetadata.title: Sync Metadata Configuration
syncMetadata.description: Configuration for embedding sync metadata in output files.

embed.title: Embed Metadata
embed.description: Embed _syncMetadata block in each YAML/JSON file for conflict detection and audit.

retryConfig.title: Retry Configuration
retryConfig.description: Configuration for retrying failed API calls.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for transient failures.

retryDelaySeconds.title: Initial Retry Delay
retryDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay in seconds before first retry (doubles with each attempt).

maxRetryDelaySeconds.title: Max Retry Delay
maxRetryDelaySeconds.description: Maximum delay in seconds between retries (caps exponential backoff).

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for API operations.
